subject: siren-wilding
q: Is Siren's waist twenty-five or twenty-six?
detail:
Her v5 Nereid profile reads 34–26–38. The Archive carries 34–25–38. One inch, one document each, and no third source to break it. Every other measurement on every other Ghost Haven profile matched the Archive exactly on this pass — thirty-one profiles checked, and this is the only silent disagreement among them, which makes it likelier to be a transcription slip than a change. It is not filed either way until somebody says so out loud.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. TWENTY-SIX. RETIRED.
